title: [OPUS 5.5] Interactive 3D movie entirely by coding using Claude
author: RageshAntony
selftext:
Claude Opus 5.5 is capable of designing an Interactive 3D movie. Good for game cutscenes.

Prompt:

Generate a animated 3D movie scene representation of this image using Three.JS or Babylon.JS. choose best one in order to get interactive movie scene. Models should be high quality. design all of them yourself. use anime style:

"a rainy night with lightning , old man drinking hot coffee is watching from a porch, kids playing in the street, bullock carts riding in the road, stalls selling foods, people carrying umbrella, after some time drinking the coffee that old man is standing up and walking towards the stall selling foods and reaching the stall and buying things from the stall.

dogs running , fallen leaves flying, birds flying in the sky, stormy , windy, countryside, artistic anime style,"
